words.gloss: those who do not agree or associate with one

literal: Than a person living by going behind those who do not agree, being said to have perished at that very instant is better.
translation: Rather than living by following behind those who do not respect or agree with them, it is far better for a person to be spoken of as having perished at that very moment.
modern: தம்மை மதிக்காத பகைவர்களின் பின்னே சென்று ஒருவன் உயிர்வாழ்வதை விட, அவன் அப்போதே அழிந்துவிட்டான் என்று பிறரால் சொல்லப்படுவது நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of self-respect over a compromised life. The poet compares two choices: living subserviently by following those who are hostile or disrespectful ('ஒட்டார் பின் சென்று வாழ்தல்'), and dying or being ruined at that very moment ('அந்நிலையே கெட்டான் எனப்படுதல்'). The word 'ஒட்டார்' refers to adversaries or those who do not align with one's dignity. The couplet declares that it is far better ('நன்று') to be known as having perished instantly with honor intact than to survive by begging or serving those who look down upon you.
